notablePrerequisites:
Bigger on the Inside attached to Farmstead Gleaner.
Farmstead Gleaner does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by tapping it, adding {2} and causing the next spell you cast to have cascade.
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
Optionally, you may cast any spell to get infinite cascade triggers based off the mana value of that spell.
